issue.title: [Epic] Authentication (better-auth)
issue.body:
### Summary

Epic tracking authentication on the **Expo SDK 56 CNG (Android-only) baseline**. **Important:** most of this epic already exists in the current baseline and is being **hardened/refactored**, not built from scratch. The junior handoff in [PR #82](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/82) is **not** being merged and is referenced only for anti-patterns.

**Verify pass (2026-07):** All sub-issues #88–#93 merged and closed. Epic complete.

What already ships on main:
- `src/services/api.ts` with token injection — but via a **mutable module singleton** (`let _activeToken`) and a **fake-async** `getHeaders`; `publicRequest` lacks logging (#88).
- `src/services/keychain.ts` (multi-account, namespaced `fluent.auth.<userId>`) on **`react-native-keychain`** — to be migrated to `expo-secure-store` (#89).
- `src/app/tabs/LoginScreen.tsx` with validation/loading/error + embedded forgot-password view modes (#90, #91).
- `PrivacyPolicyPage.tsx` / `TermsOfUsePage.tsx` already routed in `AppNavigator` (#92).
- Launch auth bootstrap already in `App.tsx` (ad-hoc, dynamic import, incomplete sign-out) (#93).

### Sub-issues
- [x] #88
- [x] #89
- [x] #90
- [x] #91
- [x] #92
- [x] #93

### Dependency ordering
1. **#88** (token accessor) → unblocks #93, #100, #113.
2. **#89** (expo-secure-store migration) → unblocks #93; needs jest mocks from #111.
3. **#93** (session bootstrap) builds on #88 + #89.
4. **#90 / #91** (login + forgot-password) consume #88/#89.
5. **#92** is small and independent.
- Benefits from F1 (#109 env) and E2 (#107 offline dev).
- Blocks C2 (#100 upload token injection).

### Links
- Anti-pattern reference only (not merging): [PR #82](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/pull/82)
- Account switcher already tracked: #84, #85, #86, #87 (reference only — do not duplicate)
